# Constructing Idea Genomes

## Core principle

Encode ideas into comparable causal components rather than persuasive prose. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a single constrained implementation task
- cosmetic renaming presented as novelty
